campaign_dialogue.edric_campaign.greetin.source: The grain you saw outside is real. So is the road that killed the people sent to clear it.
campaign_dialogue.edric_campaign.greetin.text: The grain you saw outside is real. So is the road that killed the people sent to clear it.

campaign_dialogue.edric_campaign.lines.0.source: Edric: I found the command ledger six years ago. I sealed it. I was afraid of what the houses here would become without Vargan protection.
campaign_dialogue.edric_campaign.lines.0.text: Edric: I found the command ledger six years ago. I sealed it. I was afraid of what the houses here would become without Vargan protection.

campaign_dialogue.edric_campaign.lines.1.source: Kael: You inherited the crime. Keeping its proof hidden was your choice.
campaign_dialogue.edric_campaign.lines.1.text: Kael: You inherited the crime. Keeping its proof hidden was your choice.

campaign_dialogue.edric_campaign.lines.2.source: Edric: Yes. The renewal is my choice too. I need households to witness the seal before the grain moves.
campaign_dialogue.edric_campaign.lines.2.text: Edric: Yes. The renewal is my choice too. I need households to witness the seal before the grain moves.

campaign_dialogue.edric_campaign.lines.3.source: Kael: People who must sign to feed their children cannot give you a free oath.
campaign_dialogue.edric_campaign.lines.3.text: Kael: People who must sign to feed their children cannot give you a free oath.

campaign_dialogue.edric_campaign.lines.4.source: Edric: Then give me another way to get those carts through. Do not give me a principle and leave before winter.
campaign_dialogue.edric_campaign.lines.4.text: Edric: Then give me another way to get those carts through. Do not give me a principle and leave before winter.

campaign_dialogue.edric_campaign.variant.source: I have withdrawn the household signatures. My officers have the same order.
campaign_dialogue.edric_campaign.variant.text: I have withdrawn the household signatures. My officers have the same order.

campaign_dialogue.edric_campaign.variant.source: Edric: I will testify without my seal. I will supply the road under the assembly's account.
campaign_dialogue.edric_campaign.variant.text: Edric: I will testify without my seal. I will supply the road under the assembly's account.

campaign_dialogue.edric_campaign.variant.source: Edric: Not mine to shelter behind after this.
campaign_dialogue.edric_campaign.variant.text: Edric: Not mine to shelter behind after this.

campaign_dialogue.edric_campaign.variant.source: I will say what you make me say. Do not dress it as consent.
campaign_dialogue.edric_campaign.variant.text: I will say what you make me say. Do not dress it as consent.

campaign_dialogue.edric_campaign.variant.source: Kael: Your ledger is evidence. Your threatened words are not a new covenant.
campaign_dialogue.edric_campaign.variant.text: Kael: Your ledger is evidence. Your threatened words are not a new covenant.

campaign_dialogue.edric_campaign.variant.source: Edric: At least we agree on the shape of what you are doing.
campaign_dialogue.edric_campaign.variant.text: Edric: At least we agree on the shape of what you are doing.

campaign_dialogue.edric_castle.greeting.source: Sit if your leg is hurting. Then tell me exactly what you found.
campaign_dialogue.edric_castle.greeting.text: Sit if your leg is hurting. Then tell me exactly what you found.

campaign_dialogue.edric_castle.lines.0.source: Kael: Your soldiers reclaimed the tokens after the road repairs.
campaign_dialogue.edric_castle.lines.0.text: Kael: Your soldiers reclaimed the tokens after the road repairs.

campaign_dialogue.edric_castle.lines.1.source: Edric: I ordered containment. The repairs had exposed a cache the shrine could no longer quiet.
campaign_dialogue.edric_castle.lines.1.text: Edric: I ordered containment. The repairs had exposed a cache the shrine could no longer quiet.

campaign_dialogue.edric_castle.lines.2.source: Kael: You also kept the ledger closed for six years.
campaign_dialogue.edric_castle.lines.2.text: Kael: You also kept the ledger closed for six years.

campaign_dialogue.edric_castle.lines.3.source: Edric: Yes. Before you ask the next question, know that I have no smaller word for that.
campaign_dialogue.edric_castle.lines.3.text: Edric: Yes. Before you ask the next question, know that I have no smaller word for that.

campaign_dialogue.edric_proclamation.act.source: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.
campaign_dialogue.edric_proclamation.act.text: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

campaign_dialogue.edric_proclamation.act.source: Keep the renewal order with the road evidence.
campaign_dialogue.edric_proclamation.act.text: Keep the renewal order with the road evidence.

campaign_dialogue.edric_proclamation.act.source: The current order joins the older command. Protection and assent have been deliberately made the same transaction.
campaign_dialogue.edric_proclamation.act.text: The current order joins the older command. Protection and assent have been deliberately made the same transaction.

campaign_dialogue.edric_proclamation.act.source: The current order joins the older command. Protection and assent have been deliberately made the same transaction.
campaign_dialogue.edric_proclamation.act.text: The current order joins the older command. Protection and assent have been deliberately made the same transaction.

campaign_dialogue.edric_proclamation.gre.source: By order of Lord Edric Vargan: grain protection is to be restored under a renewed road covenant.
campaign_dialogue.edric_proclamation.gre.text: By order of Lord Edric Vargan: grain protection is to be restored under a renewed road covenant.

campaign_dialogue.edric_proclamation.lin.source: Each supported household must attend and witness the seal. Allotments will be entered beside its assent.
campaign_dialogue.edric_proclamation.lin.text: Each supported household must attend and witness the seal. Allotments will be entered beside its assent.

campaign_dialogue.edric_proclamation.lin.source: Kael: An order can move grain. It cannot make a hungry person's oath free.
campaign_dialogue.edric_proclamation.lin.text: Kael: An order can move grain. It cannot make a hungry person's oath free.

campaign_dialogue.edric_proclamation.var.source: The household assent column has been struck from the order.
campaign_dialogue.edric_proclamation.var.text: The household assent column has been struck from the order.

campaign_dialogue.edric_proclamation.var.source: Grain allotments remain. The account of the road is kept separately.
campaign_dialogue.edric_proclamation.var.text: Grain allotments remain. The account of the road is kept separately.

campaign_dialogue.greyfen_cart_work.acti.source: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.
campaign_dialogue.greyfen_cart_work.acti.text: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

campaign_dialogue.greyfen_cart_work.acti.source: Brace the wheel and help bring the driver inside.
campaign_dialogue.greyfen_cart_work.acti.text: Brace the wheel and help bring the driver inside.

campaign_dialogue.greyfen_cart_work.acti.source: Kael lifts while Rook lays boards. The grain and its shaken driver reach Greyfen together.
campaign_dialogue.greyfen_cart_work.acti.text: Kael lifts while Rook lays boards. The grain and its shaken driver reach Greyfen together.

campaign_dialogue.greyfen_cart_work.acti.source: Kael lifts while Rook lays boards. The grain and its shaken driver reach Greyfen together.
campaign_dialogue.greyfen_cart_work.acti.text: Kael lifts while Rook lays boards. The grain and its shaken driver reach Greyfen together.

campaign_dialogue.greyfen_cart_work.gree.source: The wheel has sunk to its hub. Rook braces the cart while the driver tries not to fall against it.
campaign_dialogue.greyfen_cart_work.gree.text: The wheel has sunk to its hub. Rook braces the cart while the driver tries not to fall against it.

campaign_dialogue.greyfen_cart_work.line.source: Rook: If you are hunting something expensive, consider this wheel. It has eaten my entire morning.
campaign_dialogue.greyfen_cart_work.line.text: Rook: If you are hunting something expensive, consider this wheel. It has eaten my entire morning.

campaign_dialogue.greyfen_cart_work.line.source: Kael: Move your hand from the spoke. I will take the weight.
campaign_dialogue.greyfen_cart_work.line.text: Kael: Move your hand from the spoke. I will take the weight.

campaign_dialogue.greyfen_cart_work.line.source: Rook: Then Anwen gets the driver, and the sacks get through the gate. In that order.
campaign_dialogue.greyfen_cart_work.line.text: Rook: Then Anwen gets the driver, and the sacks get through the gate. In that order.

campaign_dialogue.greyfen_cart_work.vari.source: The cart stands on dry boards. The driver has Anwen's cup between both hands.
campaign_dialogue.greyfen_cart_work.vari.text: The cart stands on dry boards. The driver has Anwen's cup between both hands.

campaign_dialogue.greyfen_cart_work.vari.source: Rook: Grain inside. Person inside. A profitable morning by standards I have apparently lowered.
campaign_dialogue.greyfen_cart_work.vari.text: Rook: Grain inside. Person inside. A profitable morning by standards I have apparently lowered.

campaign_dialogue.greyfen_relief_board.a.source: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.
campaign_dialogue.greyfen_relief_board.a.text: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

campaign_dialogue.greyfen_relief_board.a.source: Arrange food, treatment, and a clear exit for the assembly.
campaign_dialogue.greyfen_relief_board.a.text: Arrange food, treatment, and a clear exit for the assembly.

campaign_dialogue.greyfen_relief_board.a.source: The relief list is kept separate from testimony. Food and a safe exit are offered whether a household speaks or refuses.
campaign_dialogue.greyfen_relief_board.a.text: The relief list is kept separate from testimony. Food and a safe exit are offered whether a household speaks or refuses.

campaign_dialogue.greyfen_relief_board.a.source: The relief list is kept separate from testimony. Food and a safe exit are offered whether a household speaks or refuses.
campaign_dialogue.greyfen_relief_board.a.text: The relief list is kept separate from testimony. Food and a safe exit are offered whether a household speaks or refuses.

campaign_dialogue.greyfen_relief_board.g.source: Anwen has left spaces for grain, medicine, clean iron, and a safe bed.
campaign_dialogue.greyfen_relief_board.g.text: Anwen has left spaces for grain, medicine, clean iron, and a safe bed.

campaign_dialogue.greyfen_relief_board.l.source: Anwen: You may put your hand to one of those without agreeing to stand before the Hart.
campaign_dialogue.greyfen_relief_board.l.text: Anwen: You may put your hand to one of those without agreeing to stand before the Hart.

campaign_dialogue.greyfen_relief_board.l.source: Kael: Then keep the names of helpers away from the renewal seal.
campaign_dialogue.greyfen_relief_board.l.text: Kael: Then keep the names of helpers away from the renewal seal.

campaign_dialogue.greyfen_relief_board.v.source: Grain sacks and clean cloth sit beside the assembly. The way out remains clear.
campaign_dialogue.greyfen_relief_board.v.text: Grain sacks and clean cloth sit beside the assembly. The way out remains clear.

campaign_dialogue.greyfen_relief_board.v.source: Kael: Practical help before an oath. Nobody has to become evidence to receive it.
campaign_dialogue.greyfen_relief_board.v.text: Kael: Practical help before an oath. Nobody has to become evidence to receive it.

campaign_dialogue.greyfen_road_work.acti.source: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.
campaign_dialogue.greyfen_road_work.acti.text: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

campaign_dialogue.greyfen_road_work.acti.source: Lay clean boards and preserve the exposed fragments.
campaign_dialogue.greyfen_road_work.acti.text: Lay clean boards and preserve the exposed fragments.

campaign_dialogue.greyfen_road_work.acti.source: The crossing is repaired. Refugee marks remain visible beside it instead of disappearing beneath new fill.
campaign_dialogue.greyfen_road_work.acti.text: The crossing is repaired. Refugee marks remain visible beside it instead of disappearing beneath new fill.

campaign_dialogue.greyfen_road_work.acti.source: The crossing is repaired. Refugee marks remain visible beside it instead of disappearing beneath new fill.
campaign_dialogue.greyfen_road_work.acti.text: The crossing is repaired. Refugee marks remain visible beside it instead of disappearing beneath new fill.

campaign_dialogue.greyfen_road_work.gree.source: Rain has opened the repaired strip where Bram found the old tokens.
campaign_dialogue.greyfen_road_work.gree.text: Rain has opened the repaired strip where Bram found the old tokens.

campaign_dialogue.greyfen_road_work.line.source: Tor: Put the clean boards over the rut. Leave the marked pieces where we can read them.
campaign_dialogue.greyfen_road_work.line.text: Tor: Put the clean boards over the rut. Leave the marked pieces where we can read them.

campaign_dialogue.greyfen_road_work.line.source: Kael: Repair the route without burying what it exposed.
campaign_dialogue.greyfen_road_work.line.text: Kael: Repair the route without burying what it exposed.

campaign_dialogue.greyfen_road_work.vari.source: Clean boards span the rut. The marked fragments lie beside the warning post.
campaign_dialogue.greyfen_road_work.vari.text: Clean boards span the rut. The marked fragments lie beside the warning post.

campaign_dialogue.greyfen_road_work.vari.source: Kael: People can pass here. The evidence has not gone back under their wheels.
campaign_dialogue.greyfen_road_work.vari.text: Kael: People can pass here. The evidence has not gone back under their wheels.

campaign_dialogue.halvern.actions.0.cost.source: Copies preserve the refusal, not every memory the fragment carries.
campaign_dialogue.halvern.actions.0.cost.text: Copies preserve the refusal, not every memory the fragment carries.

campaign_dialogue.halvern.actions.0.labe.source: Preserve the refusal as testimony. Do not demand another oath.
campaign_dialogue.halvern.actions.0.labe.text: Preserve the refusal as testimony. Do not demand another oath.

campaign_dialogue.halvern.actions.0.prev.source: Kael copies the sanctuary order and refusal. The bounded memory stays with the blade; it cannot consent for a living person.
campaign_dialogue.halvern.actions.0.prev.text: Kael copies the sanctuary order and refusal. The bounded memory stays with the blade; it cannot consent for a living person.

campaign_dialogue.halvern.actions.0.resu.text: Kael copies the sanctuary order and refusal. The bounded memory stays with the blade; it cannot consent for a living person.

campaign_dialogue.halvern.actions.1.cost.source: Copies preserve the refusal, not every memory the fragment carries.
campaign_dialogue.halvern.actions.1.cost.text: Copies preserve the refusal, not every memory the fragment carries.

campaign_dialogue.halvern.actions.1.labe.source: Record the refusal, then release the exhausted memory.
campaign_dialogue.halvern.actions.1.labe.text: Record the refusal, then release the exhausted memory.

campaign_dialogue.halvern.actions.1.prev.source: The order and refusal are copied before the fragment settles. Kael keeps his own confession in the same account.
campaign_dialogue.halvern.actions.1.prev.text: The order and refusal are copied before the fragment settles. Kael keeps his own confession in the same account.

campaign_dialogue.halvern.actions.1.resu.source: The order and refusal are copied before the fragment settles. Kael keeps his own confession in the same account.
campaign_dialogue.halvern.actions.1.resu.text: The order and refusal are copied before the fragment settles. Kael keeps his own confession in the same account.

campaign_dialogue.halvern.actions.2.cost.source: Copies preserve the refusal, not every memory the fragment carries.
campaign_dialogue.halvern.actions.2.cost.text: Copies preserve the refusal, not every memory the fragment carries.

campaign_dialogue.halvern.actions.2.labe.source: Keep the copied order. End the remaining grave binding.
campaign_dialogue.halvern.actions.2.labe.text: Keep the copied order. End the remaining grave binding.

campaign_dialogue.halvern.actions.2.prev.source: The irreplaceable shape is destroyed after its command is recorded. The copied proof remains; its surrounding memories are lost.
campaign_dialogue.halvern.actions.2.prev.text: The irreplaceable shape is destroyed after its command is recorded. The copied proof remains; its surrounding memories are lost.

campaign_dialogue.halvern.actions.2.resu.source: The irreplaceable shape is destroyed after its command is recorded. The copied proof remains; its surrounding memories are lost.
campaign_dialogue.halvern.actions.2.resu.text: The irreplaceable shape is destroyed after its command is recorded. The copied proof remains; its surrounding memories are lost.

campaign_dialogue.halvern.greeting.source: Do not close it. There are still people on the road.
campaign_dialogue.halvern.greeting.text: Do not close it. There are still people on the road.

campaign_dialogue.halvern.lines.0.source: Halvern: Sanctuary under the Vargan seal. Those were the words. They came because of the words.
campaign_dialogue.halvern.lines.0.text: Halvern: Sanctuary under the Vargan seal. Those were the words. They came because of the words.

campaign_dialogue.halvern.lines.1.source: Kael: What happened after you refused?
campaign_dialogue.halvern.lines.1.text: Kael: What happened after you refused?

campaign_dialogue.halvern.lines.2.source: Halvern: Rope. The yard. Dawn. Do not close it.
campaign_dialogue.halvern.lines.2.text: Halvern: Rope. The yard. Dawn. Do not close it.

campaign_dialogue.halvern.lines.3.source: Kael: You cannot tell me about Edric. Your memory ends here.
campaign_dialogue.halvern.lines.3.text: Kael: You cannot tell me about Edric. Your memory ends here.

campaign_dialogue.halvern.lines.4.source: Kael: I was ordered to retreat from another road. There were people we had promised to escort. I went.
campaign_dialogue.halvern.lines.4.text: Kael: I was ordered to retreat from another road. There were people we had promised to escort. I went.

campaign_dialogue.halvern.lines.5.source: Kael: I wrote that we could not hold. I left out that I never went back.
campaign_dialogue.halvern.lines.5.text: Kael: I wrote that we could not hold. I left out that I never went back.

campaign_dialogue.halvern.lines.6.source: Halvern: There are still people on the road.
campaign_dialogue.halvern.lines.6.text: Halvern: There are still people on the road.

campaign_dialogue.mill_distribution.gree.source: Clean reserve sacks stand apart from the mill's working channel.
campaign_dialogue.mill_distribution.gree.text: Clean reserve sacks stand apart from the mill's working channel.

campaign_dialogue.mill_distribution.line.source: Mira: A short ration is a cost. So is using tainted machinery. The ledger does not make either disappear.
campaign_dialogue.mill_distribution.line.text: Mira: A short ration is a cost. So is using tainted machinery. The ledger does not make either disappear.

campaign_dialogue.mill_distribution.line.source: Kael: Keep the record whatever method gets the flour through.
campaign_dialogue.mill_distribution.line.text: Kael: Keep the record whatever method gets the flour through.

campaign_dialogue.mill_distribution.vari.source: The tainted channel is closed. Reserve sacks are divided by household need.
campaign_dialogue.mill_distribution.vari.text: The tainted channel is closed. Reserve sacks are divided by household need.

campaign_dialogue.mill_distribution.vari.source: Mira: Clean repair takes time. For now, these sacks are what keeps the closure from becoming another barred gate.
campaign_dialogue.mill_distribution.vari.text: Mira: Clean repair takes time. For now, these sacks are what keeps the closure from becoming another barred gate.

campaign_dialogue.mill_distribution.vari.source: The limited run is watched. Contaminated stock is stacked separately.
campaign_dialogue.mill_distribution.vari.text: The limited run is watched. Contaminated stock is stacked separately.

campaign_dialogue.mill_distribution.vari.source: Mira: It gets flour through today. It does not settle what went into the channels or the work of replacing them.
campaign_dialogue.mill_distribution.vari.text: Mira: It gets flour through today. It does not settle what went into the channels or the work of replacing them.

campaign_dialogue.mill_distribution.vari.source: Clean repairs have begun. The first replacement sacks go to affected households.
campaign_dialogue.mill_distribution.vari.text: Clean repairs have begun. The first replacement sacks go to affected households.

campaign_dialogue.mill_distribution.vari.source: Kael: The accounts stay public. Repair is work that people can return to see.
campaign_dialogue.mill_distribution.vari.text: Kael: The accounts stay public. Repair is work that people can return to see.

campaign_dialogue.miller_record.actions..source: Closure uses reserves; supervision retains contamination risk; restitution takes clean materials and labor.
campaign_dialogue.miller_record.actions..text: Closure uses reserves; supervision retains contamination risk; restitution takes clean materials and labor.

campaign_dialogue.miller_record.actions..source: Close the tainted channels. Preserve the ledger and ration reserves.
campaign_dialogue.miller_record.actions..text: Close the tainted channels. Preserve the ledger and ration reserves.

campaign_dialogue.miller_record.actions..source: The ledger is kept. The mill closes while relief grain is divided; workers lose shifts and the village must carry sacks from the reserve.
campaign_dialogue.miller_record.actions..text: The ledger is kept. The mill closes while relief grain is divided; workers lose shifts and the village must carry sacks from the reserve.

campaign_dialogue.miller_record.actions..text: Closure uses reserves; supervision retains contamination risk; restitution takes clean materials and labor.

campaign_dialogue.miller_record.actions..source: Keep supervised milling. Replace the contaminated working copy.
campaign_dialogue.miller_record.actions..text: Keep supervised milling. Replace the contaminated working copy.

campaign_dialogue.miller_record.actions..source: The ruined working sheet is burned after a signed copy is kept. Supervised milling supplies flour while separate clean channels are prepared.
campaign_dialogue.miller_record.actions..text: The ruined working sheet is burned after a signed copy is kept. Supervised milling supplies flour while separate clean channels are prepared.

campaign_dialogue.miller_record.actions..source: Closure uses reserves; supervision retains contamination risk; restitution takes clean materials and labor.
campaign_dialogue.miller_record.actions..text: Closure uses reserves; supervision retains contamination risk; restitution takes clean materials and labor.

campaign_dialogue.miller_record.actions..source: Post the accounts. Begin clean repairs and pay for restitution.
campaign_dialogue.miller_record.actions..text: Post the accounts. Begin clean repairs and pay for restitution.

campaign_dialogue.miller_record.actions..source: The accounts are copied publicly. Workers begin replacing the channels; the first clean flour goes to affected households.
campaign_dialogue.miller_record.actions..text: The accounts are copied publicly. Workers begin replacing the channels; the first clean flour goes to affected households.

campaign_dialogue.miller_record.actions..source: The accounts are copied publicly. Workers begin replacing the channels; the first clean flour goes to affected households.
campaign_dialogue.miller_record.actions..text: The accounts are copied publicly. Workers begin replacing the channels; the first clean flour goes to affected households.

campaign_dialogue.miller_record.greeting.source: The measure is hollow under its mark. The short weight has been feeding the same households for years.
campaign_dialogue.miller_record.greeting.text: The measure is hollow under its mark. The short weight has been feeding the same households for years.

campaign_dialogue.miller_record.lines.0.source: Kael: The ledger counts ash as fertilizer. The wagon totals match the refugee register.
campaign_dialogue.miller_record.lines.0.text: Kael: The ledger counts ash as fertilizer. The wagon totals match the refugee register.

campaign_dialogue.miller_record.lines.1.source: Mira: Closing the mill stops the tainted channels. It also stops the flour coming through them.
campaign_dialogue.miller_record.lines.1.text: Mira: Closing the mill stops the tainted channels. It also stops the flour coming through them.

campaign_dialogue.miller_record.lines.2.source: Kael: The record leaves with us whatever we do to the machinery.
campaign_dialogue.miller_record.lines.2.text: Kael: The record leaves with us whatever we do to the machinery.

campaign_dialogue.miller_record.lines.3.source: Mira: Good. Now decide how we feed the people who did not choose what was ground here.
campaign_dialogue.miller_record.lines.3.text: Mira: Good. Now decide how we feed the people who did not choose what was ground here.

campaign_dialogue.names_decision.actions.source: Delay leaves the renewal order unchallenged; publicity can endanger people who carry the account.
campaign_dialogue.names_decision.actions.text: Delay leaves the renewal order unchallenged; publicity can endanger people who carry the account.

campaign_dialogue.names_decision.actions.source: Publish the recovered names and order. Remove family addresses.
campaign_dialogue.names_decision.actions.text: Publish the recovered names and order. Remove family addresses.

campaign_dialogue.names_decision.actions.source: The dead are named publicly and Edric's order is challenged. Family addresses stay off the board; fear and solidarity both follow.
campaign_dialogue.names_decision.actions.text: The dead are named publicly and Edric's order is challenged. Family addresses stay off the board; fear and solidarity both follow.

campaign_dialogue.names_decision.actions.text: The dead are named publicly and Edric's order is challenged. Family addresses stay off the board; fear and solidarity both follow.

campaign_dialogue.names_decision.actions.source: Delay leaves the renewal order unchallenged; publicity can endanger people who carry the account.
campaign_dialogue.names_decision.actions.text: Delay leaves the renewal order unchallenged; publicity can endanger people who carry the account.

campaign_dialogue.names_decision.actions.source: Keep protected copies until the assembly. Tell each affected household.
campaign_dialogue.names_decision.actions.text: Keep protected copies until the assembly. Tell each affected household.

campaign_dialogue.names_decision.actions.source: Anwen and Rook keep separate copies. Affected households are warned privately before the assembly; the delay leaves the public order unchallenged for now.
campaign_dialogue.names_decision.actions.text: Anwen and Rook keep separate copies. Affected households are warned privately before the assembly; the delay leaves the public order unchallenged for now.

campaign_dialogue.names_decision.actions.text: Anwen and Rook keep separate copies. Affected households are warned privately before the assembly; the delay leaves the public order unchallenged for now.

campaign_dialogue.names_decision.greetin.source: Rook puts a clean sheet over the family addresses before he hands you the register.
campaign_dialogue.names_decision.greetin.text: Rook puts a clean sheet over the family addresses before he hands you the register.

campaign_dialogue.names_decision.lines.0.source: Rook: The people who died can be named. Where their grandchildren sleep is not the same fact.
campaign_dialogue.names_decision.lines.0.text: Rook: The people who died can be named. Where their grandchildren sleep is not the same fact.

campaign_dialogue.names_decision.lines.1.source: Anwen: Bram found the tokens in the repaired road. Sella brought one for a burial reading. Oren restored the first name beneath his paint.
campaign_dialogue.names_decision.lines.1.text: Anwen: Bram found the tokens in the repaired road. Sella brought one for a burial reading. Oren restored the first name beneath his paint.

campaign_dialogue.names_decision.lines.2.source: Kael: The name loosened what the hidden road had kept disordered.
campaign_dialogue.names_decision.lines.2.text: Kael: The name loosened what the hidden road had kept disordered.

campaign_dialogue.names_decision.lines.3.source: Anwen: And my thread failed to contain it. Vargan's men came afterward for the tokens.
campaign_dialogue.names_decision.lines.3.text: Anwen: And my thread failed to contain it. Vargan's men came afterward for the tokens.

campaign_dialogue.names_decision.lines.4.source: Rook: Now Edric wants those households at a renewal. No signature, no grain. Your copies will reach them before his guards do.
campaign_dialogue.names_decision.lines.4.text: Rook: Now Edric wants those households at a renewal. No signature, no grain. Your copies will reach them before his guards do.

campaign_dialogue.renewal_record.greetin.source: The old covenant hid a road. The proposed renewal would have hidden an account.
campaign_dialogue.renewal_record.greetin.text: The old covenant hid a road. The proposed renewal would have hidden an account.

campaign_dialogue.renewal_record.lines.0.source: The victims trusted a promise of sanctuary. The witnesses to concealment were frightened into agreement.
campaign_dialogue.renewal_record.lines.0.text: The victims trusted a promise of sanctuary. The witnesses to concealment were frightened into agreement.

campaign_dialogue.renewal_record.lines.1.source: Kael: Copies prove the crime. A new promise must belong to the person who makes it. No ration list can lend somebody else's consent.
campaign_dialogue.renewal_record.lines.1.text: Kael: Copies prove the crime. A new promise must belong to the person who makes it. No ration list can lend somebody else's consent.

campaign_dialogue.report_decision.action.source: Public disclosure can expose witnesses; private or retained evidence delays the wider account.
campaign_dialogue.report_decision.action.text: Public disclosure can expose witnesses; private or retained evidence delays the wider account.

campaign_dialogue.report_decision.action.source: Give Anwen the token privately. Stay to protect those who speak.
campaign_dialogue.report_decision.action.text: Give Anwen the token privately. Stay to protect those who speak.

campaign_dialogue.report_decision.action.source: Anwen recognizes the older name and agrees to open the account. Kael stays to help protect its living witnesses.
campaign_dialogue.report_decision.action.text: Anwen recognizes the older name and agrees to open the account. Kael stays to help protect its living witnesses.

campaign_dialogue.report_decision.action.source: Public disclosure can expose witnesses; private or retained evidence delays the wider account.
campaign_dialogue.report_decision.action.text: Public disclosure can expose witnesses; private or retained evidence delays the wider account.

campaign_dialogue.report_decision.action.source: Make the evidence public. Stay to keep the witnesses safe.
campaign_dialogue.report_decision.action.text: Make the evidence public. Stay to keep the witnesses safe.

campaign_dialogue.report_decision.action.source: The token and wire are pinned beneath the contract. Some doors close; somebody brings dry cloth to cover the token. Kael remains responsible for the people newly visible.
campaign_dialogue.report_decision.action.text: The token and wire are pinned beneath the contract. Some doors close; somebody brings dry cloth to cover the token. Kael remains responsible for the people newly visible.

campaign_dialogue.report_decision.action.source: Public disclosure can expose witnesses; private or retained evidence delays the wider account.
campaign_dialogue.report_decision.action.text: Public disclosure can expose witnesses; private or retained evidence delays the wider account.

campaign_dialogue.report_decision.action.source: Keep the token. Make protected copies and stay with the investigation.
campaign_dialogue.report_decision.action.text: Keep the token. Make protected copies and stay with the investigation.

campaign_dialogue.report_decision.action.source: Kael keeps the original and commits to copies. Anwen distrusts the delay, but he has promised to remain with the people who must carry the account.
campaign_dialogue.report_decision.action.text: Kael keeps the original and commits to copies. Anwen distrusts the delay, but he has promised to remain with the people who must carry the account.

campaign_dialogue.report_decision.greeti.source: Anwen puts three empty cups beside the coat Oren left. Rook waits by the door.
campaign_dialogue.report_decision.greeti.text: Anwen puts three empty cups beside the coat Oren left. Rook waits by the door.

campaign_dialogue.report_decision.lines..source: Kael: The creatures gathered their belongings. Someone alive bound the token afterward and tried to remove it.
campaign_dialogue.report_decision.lines..text: Kael: The creatures gathered their belongings. Someone alive bound the token afterward and tried to remove it.

campaign_dialogue.report_decision.lines..source: Anwen: I recognize the old carving. You can give it to me, show the village, or keep it while we make copies.
campaign_dialogue.report_decision.lines..text: Anwen: I recognize the old carving. You can give it to me, show the village, or keep it while we make copies.

campaign_dialogue.report_decision.lines..source: Rook: If you show it, show the people behind it a way to stay safe as well.
campaign_dialogue.report_decision.lines..text: Rook: If you show it, show the people behind it a way to stay safe as well.

campaign_dialogue.report_decision.lines..source: Kael: I will stay. The payment ends the hunt. It does not settle what I now know.
campaign_dialogue.report_decision.lines..text: Kael: I will stay. The payment ends the hunt. It does not settle what I now know.

campaign_dialogue.retain_evidence.greeti.source: A thumb-sized crow. Fresh paint above a name cut into older wood.
campaign_dialogue.retain_evidence.greeti.text: A thumb-sized crow. Fresh paint above a name cut into older wood.

campaign_dialogue.retain_evidence.lines..source: Kael: Oren was making something someone had erased readable again.
campaign_dialogue.retain_evidence.lines..text: Kael: Oren was making something someone had erased readable again.

campaign_dialogue.retain_evidence.lines..source: Kael: Keeping this close gives me time. It also leaves everyone else waiting for an account.
campaign_dialogue.retain_evidence.lines..text: Kael: Keeping this close gives me time. It also leaves everyone else waiting for an account.

campaign_dialogue.side_contracts.actions.source: Ask Tor about the marks in his iron.
campaign_dialogue.side_contracts.actions.text: Ask Tor about the marks in his iron.

campaign_dialogue.side_contracts.actions.source: Help Mira find another fever treatment.
campaign_dialogue.side_contracts.actions.text: Help Mira find another fever treatment.

campaign_dialogue.side_contracts.actions.source: Hear Toma's account of the sheepfold.
campaign_dialogue.side_contracts.actions.text: Hear Toma's account of the sheepfold.

campaign_dialogue.side_contracts.actions.source: Follow the watch that left an empty grave.
campaign_dialogue.side_contracts.actions.text: Follow the watch that left an empty grave.

campaign_dialogue.side_contracts.actions.source: Return Oren's thread to a named place.
campaign_dialogue.side_contracts.actions.text: Return Oren's thread to a named place.

campaign_dialogue.side_contracts.actions.source: Recover the true weight of the ash.
campaign_dialogue.side_contracts.actions.text: Recover the true weight of the ash.

campaign_dialogue.side_contracts.actions.source: Walk Rook's road against the waystone.
campaign_dialogue.side_contracts.actions.text: Walk Rook's road against the waystone.

campaign_dialogue.side_contracts.actions.source: Light a candle for each missing traveler.
campaign_dialogue.side_contracts.actions.text: Light a candle for each missing traveler.

campaign_dialogue.side_contracts.greetin.source: Elna has pinned a bell cord here. Tor has weighted a note with a bent hinge. Mira's paper smells of roots.
campaign_dialogue.side_contracts.greetin.text: Elna has pinned a bell cord here. Tor has weighted a note with a bent hinge. Mira's paper smells of roots.

campaign_dialogue.side_contracts.lines.0.source: Some ask for payment. Some ask that you knock quietly. Rook's note has a road drawn on the back.
campaign_dialogue.side_contracts.lines.0.text: Some ask for payment. Some ask that you knock quietly. Rook's note has a road drawn on the back.

campaign_dialogue.side_contracts.lines.1.source: Kael: People to return to. Not just work to finish.
campaign_dialogue.side_contracts.lines.1.text: Kael: People to return to. Not just work to finish.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_gate_guard.acti.source: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.
campaign_dialogue.vargan_gate_guard.acti.text: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_gate_guard.acti.source: I carry testimony from the old road.
campaign_dialogue.vargan_gate_guard.acti.text: I carry testimony from the old road.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_gate_guard.acti.source: The guard steps aside without lowering his hand from the sword.
campaign_dialogue.vargan_gate_guard.acti.text: The guard steps aside without lowering his hand from the sword.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_gate_guard.acti.source: The guard steps aside without lowering his hand from the sword.
campaign_dialogue.vargan_gate_guard.acti.text: The guard steps aside without lowering his hand from the sword.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_gate_guard.gree.source: Keep the lane clear. That cart is carrying grain, not reinforcements.
campaign_dialogue.vargan_gate_guard.gree.text: Keep the lane clear. That cart is carrying grain, not reinforcements.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_gate_guard.line.source: Kael: I carry an account from Greyfen's road.
campaign_dialogue.vargan_gate_guard.line.text: Kael: I carry an account from Greyfen's road.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_gate_guard.line.source: Guard: The steward wants every token brought inside. People argue less over a missing thing when no one can show it.
campaign_dialogue.vargan_gate_guard.line.text: Guard: The steward wants every token brought inside. People argue less over a missing thing when no one can show it.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_gate_guard.line.source: Kael: Then you had better let me show it.
campaign_dialogue.vargan_gate_guard.line.text: Kael: Then you had better let me show it.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_gate_guard.vari.source: The steward says a seal was broken. I can see why he is frightened.
campaign_dialogue.vargan_gate_guard.vari.text: The steward says a seal was broken. I can see why he is frightened.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_gate_guard.vari.source: Guard: You may still leave by the gate. The road must carry people as well as orders.
campaign_dialogue.vargan_gate_guard.vari.text: Guard: You may still leave by the gate. The road must carry people as well as orders.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_ledger_choice.a.source: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.
campaign_dialogue.vargan_ledger_choice.a.text: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_ledger_choice.a.source: Kael copies the command, then takes the original in sight of the keeper. The broken seal raises suspicion; the facts survive.
campaign_dialogue.vargan_ledger_choice.a.text: Kael copies the command, then takes the original in sight of the keeper. The broken seal raises suspicion; the facts survive.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_ledger_choice.a.text: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_ledger_choice.a.source: A copy stays with the keeper. Kael conceals the original to protect the route out; the hidden removal damages trust if discovered.
campaign_dialogue.vargan_ledger_choice.a.text: A copy stays with the keeper. Kael conceals the original to protect the route out; the hidden removal damages trust if discovered.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_ledger_choice.a.text: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_ledger_choice.a.source: Keep a signed copy. Leave the original where it can be read.
campaign_dialogue.vargan_ledger_choice.a.text: Keep a signed copy. Leave the original where it can be read.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_ledger_choice.a.source: Vale signs the copy. The original stays open under the lamp, and the command proof leaves with Kael.
campaign_dialogue.vargan_ledger_choice.a.text: Vale signs the copy. The original stays open under the lamp, and the command proof leaves with Kael.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_ledger_choice.a.text: Vale signs the copy. The original stays open under the lamp, and the command proof leaves with Kael.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_ledger_choice.g.source: Sanctuary promised. Road closed. Refugee wagons transferred to shrine custody. Three columns written by three different hands.
campaign_dialogue.vargan_ledger_choice.g.text: Sanctuary promised. Road closed. Refugee wagons transferred to shrine custody. Three columns written by three different hands.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_ledger_choice.l.source: Kael: The command survived without the names. The register has the names without the command.
campaign_dialogue.vargan_ledger_choice.l.text: Kael: The command survived without the names. The register has the names without the command.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_ledger_choice.l.source: Kael: Together they establish who did what. Copy the page before any choice about its seal.
campaign_dialogue.vargan_ledger_choice.l.text: Kael: Together they establish who did what. Copy the page before any choice about its seal.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_patrol.greeting.source: We were sent for the painted tokens after the creatures gathered. Two men did not come back.
campaign_dialogue.vargan_patrol.greeting.text: We were sent for the painted tokens after the creatures gathered. Two men did not come back.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_patrol.lines.0.source: Kael: Did your orders include scratching out their names?
campaign_dialogue.vargan_patrol.lines.0.text: Kael: Did your orders include scratching out their names?

campaign_dialogue.vargan_patrol.lines.1.source: Guard: Contain the breach. Bring back every object. The paper did not say what to do when a child's name made the wire shake.
campaign_dialogue.vargan_patrol.lines.1.text: Guard: Contain the breach. Bring back every object. The paper did not say what to do when a child's name made the wire shake.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_record_keeper.g.source: I have laid the uncut page under the lamp. You may read it. I have waited too long to say that.
campaign_dialogue.vargan_record_keeper.g.text: I have laid the uncut page under the lamp. You may read it. I have waited too long to say that.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_record_keeper.l.source: Vale: Sanctuary was promised under the Vargan seal. The closure order followed on the same day.
campaign_dialogue.vargan_record_keeper.l.text: Vale: Sanctuary was promised under the Vargan seal. The closure order followed on the same day.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_record_keeper.l.source: Vale: I kept them and let the steward keep people from reading them. I will sign that fact.
campaign_dialogue.vargan_record_keeper.l.text: Vale: I kept them and let the steward keep people from reading them. I will sign that fact.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_servant.greetin.source: I set an extra place when the grain drivers are late. It does not get them here, but it keeps someone expecting them.
campaign_dialogue.vargan_servant.greetin.text: I set an extra place when the grain drivers are late. It does not get them here, but it keeps someone expecting them.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_servant.lines.0.source: The archive lamps answer names cut from the old books. Start with the marks along the shelf. Not every answer has a voice.
campaign_dialogue.vargan_servant.lines.0.text: The archive lamps answer names cut from the old books. Start with the marks along the shelf. Not every answer has a voice.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_steward.greetin.source: The empty sacks go left. The petitions go right. Do not mix them.
campaign_dialogue.vargan_steward.greetin.text: The empty sacks go left. The petitions go right. Do not mix them.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_steward.lines.0.source: Kael: Why are household signatures beside grain allotments?
campaign_dialogue.vargan_steward.lines.0.text: Kael: Why are household signatures beside grain allotments?

campaign_dialogue.vargan_steward.lines.1.source: Merrow: A supported household witnesses the renewal. Those are the terms.
campaign_dialogue.vargan_steward.lines.1.text: Merrow: A supported household witnesses the renewal. Those are the terms.

campaign_dialogue.vargan_steward.lines.2.source: Kael: Terms offered to someone hungry do not make a free promise.
campaign_dialogue.vargan_steward.lines.2.text: Kael: Terms offered to someone hungry do not make a free promise.

campaign_dialogue.village_stories.greeti.source: A bell on a windowsill. New nails beside an old hinge. Roots laid out beneath labeled jars.
campaign_dialogue.village_stories.greeti.text: A bell on a windowsill. New nails beside an old hinge. Roots laid out beneath labeled jars.

campaign_dialogue.village_stories.lines..source: Kael: What matters is whether I returned after asking them to change.
campaign_dialogue.village_stories.lines..text: Kael: What matters is whether I returned after asking them to change.

campaign_dialogue.white_hart.actions.0.c.source: Lost privilege, trade pressure, and the ongoing labor of restitution. Fewer allies mean more work for Kael.
campaign_dialogue.white_hart.actions.0.c.text: Lost privilege, trade pressure, and the ongoing labor of restitution. Fewer allies mean more work for Kael.

campaign_dialogue.white_hart.actions.0.l.source: Witness — make the account public; stay to preserve it.
campaign_dialogue.white_hart.actions.0.l.text: Witness — make the account public; stay to preserve it.

campaign_dialogue.white_hart.actions.0.p.source: Release the Hart through public acknowledgment and Kael's willing work to preserve the record.
campaign_dialogue.white_hart.actions.0.p.text: Release the Hart through public acknowledgment and Kael's willing work to preserve the record.

campaign_dialogue.white_hart.actions.1.c.source: A protected circle must preserve the truth; partial public acknowledgment leaves unresolved grievances.
campaign_dialogue.white_hart.actions.1.c.text: A protected circle must preserve the truth; partial public acknowledgment leaves unresolved grievances.

campaign_dialogue.white_hart.actions.1.l.source: Mercy — release the Hart; safeguard names and private memories.
campaign_dialogue.white_hart.actions.1.l.text: Mercy — release the Hart; safeguard names and private memories.

campaign_dialogue.white_hart.actions.1.p.source: Release the Hart while protecting private memories; institutional crimes remain on record.
campaign_dialogue.white_hart.actions.1.p.text: Release the Hart while protecting private memories; institutional crimes remain on record.

campaign_dialogue.white_hart.actions.2.c.source: Kael loses freedom and rest. The village gains time while the injustice remains unfinished.
campaign_dialogue.white_hart.actions.2.c.text: Kael loses freedom and rest. The village gains time while the injustice remains unfinished.

campaign_dialogue.white_hart.actions.2.l.source: Duty — freely carry the unresolved binding myself.
campaign_dialogue.white_hart.actions.2.l.text: Duty — freely carry the unresolved binding myself.

campaign_dialogue.white_hart.actions.2.p.source: Kael willingly carries the continuing binding. No other person is pledged.
campaign_dialogue.white_hart.actions.2.p.text: Kael willingly carries the continuing binding. No other person is pledged.

campaign_dialogue.white_hart.actions.3.c.source: Irreplaceable memories are lost. Dispersal harms the land and future harvests.
campaign_dialogue.white_hart.actions.3.c.text: Irreplaceable memories are lost. Dispersal harms the land and future harvests.

campaign_dialogue.white_hart.actions.3.l.source: Ash — destroy the Hart; keep the human record and face the loss.
campaign_dialogue.white_hart.actions.3.l.text: Ash — destroy the Hart; keep the human record and face the loss.

campaign_dialogue.white_hart.actions.3.p.source: Destroy the complete witness by combat; the copied human record survives.
campaign_dialogue.white_hart.actions.3.p.text: Destroy the complete witness by combat; the copied human record survives.

campaign_dialogue.white_hart.greeting.source: You have kept the account where a living hand can reach it. That is something the old oath would not allow.
campaign_dialogue.white_hart.greeting.text: You have kept the account where a living hand can reach it. That is something the old oath would not allow.

campaign_dialogue.white_hart.lines.0.source: Kael: The grain condition is broken. No one standing here has to promise you anything to eat.
campaign_dialogue.white_hart.lines.0.text: Kael: The grain condition is broken. No one standing here has to promise you anything to eat.

campaign_dialogue.white_hart.lines.1.source: The White Hart: I remember the gate shut. I remember the road hidden. I remember the soldiers entering. I will not tell you those were one man's act.
campaign_dialogue.white_hart.lines.1.text: The White Hart: I remember the gate shut. I remember the road hidden. I remember the soldiers entering. I will not tell you those were one man's act.

campaign_dialogue.white_hart.lines.2.source: Kael: The copies survive. I will freely keep what we have recovered. I cannot swear for the people who refused.
campaign_dialogue.white_hart.lines.2.text: Kael: The copies survive. I will freely keep what we have recovered. I cannot swear for the people who refused.

campaign_dialogue.white_hart.lines.3.source: The White Hart: One willing keeper of an account is enough to begin. Others may share that work. None may be given it by force.
campaign_dialogue.white_hart.lines.3.text: The White Hart: One willing keeper of an account is enough to begin. Others may share that work. None may be given it by force.

campaign_dialogue.white_hart.lines.4.source: The White Hart: Make the account public and I will leave its judgment with you. Release me quietly and preserve the record without opening every private memory.
campaign_dialogue.white_hart.lines.4.text: The White Hart: Make the account public and I will leave its judgment with you. Release me quietly and preserve the record without opening every private memory.

campaign_dialogue.white_hart.lines.5.source: The White Hart: Or carry the unresolved binding yourself. Or destroy me and lose what no copy holds.
campaign_dialogue.white_hart.lines.5.text: The White Hart: Or carry the unresolved binding yourself. Or destroy me and lose what no copy holds.

campaign_dialogue.white_hart.lines.6.source: Kael: Releasing you does not erase the house's crime. Protecting a family does not protect Edric from the record.
campaign_dialogue.white_hart.lines.6.text: Kael: Releasing you does not erase the house's crime. Protecting a family does not protect Edric from the record.

campaign_dialogue.white_hart.lines.7.source: The White Hart: Then choose whose work begins when mine ends.
campaign_dialogue.white_hart.lines.7.text: The White Hart: Then choose whose work begins when mine ends.

campaign_dialogue.witness_-3.greeting.source: I can tell you where the road ran. I have removed the family homes from the copy.
campaign_dialogue.witness_-3.greeting.text: I can tell you where the road ran. I have removed the family homes from the copy.

campaign_dialogue.witness_-3.lines.0.source: Rook: My grandmother kept these names. She did not leave me permission to hand you every private part of her life.
campaign_dialogue.witness_-3.lines.0.text: Rook: My grandmother kept these names. She did not leave me permission to hand you every private part of her life.

campaign_dialogue.witness_-3.lines.1.source: Rook: The road is evidence. The addresses are not.
campaign_dialogue.witness_-3.lines.1.text: Rook: The road is evidence. The addresses are not.

campaign_dialogue.witness_-3.variants.0..source: You have the route. You do not have my promise to stand in a rite.
campaign_dialogue.witness_-3.variants.0..text: You have the route. You do not have my promise to stand in a rite.

campaign_dialogue.witness_-3.variants.0..source: Rook: A record is not a person agreeing. Keep that straight.
campaign_dialogue.witness_-3.variants.0..text: Rook: A record is not a person agreeing. Keep that straight.

campaign_dialogue.witness_-7.greeting.source: I grew the medicine in the ash bed. Families were not told.
campaign_dialogue.witness_-7.greeting.text: I grew the medicine in the ash bed. Families were not told.

campaign_dialogue.witness_-7.lines.0.source: Mira: Some choose it now. Others choose the clean roots. I still treat them.
campaign_dialogue.witness_-7.lines.0.text: Mira: Some choose it now. Others choose the clean roots. I still treat them.

campaign_dialogue.witness_-7.lines.1.source: Mira: The cure was real. So was the choice I kept from them.
campaign_dialogue.witness_-7.lines.1.text: Mira: The cure was real. So was the choice I kept from them.

campaign_dialogue.witness_-7.variants.0..source: The ash bed is closed. I will explain why the replacement takes longer.
campaign_dialogue.witness_-7.variants.0..text: The ash bed is closed. I will explain why the replacement takes longer.

campaign_dialogue.witness_-7.variants.0..source: Mira: There will be shortages. I will not hide them behind a clean label.
campaign_dialogue.witness_-7.variants.0..text: Mira: There will be shortages. I will not hide them behind a clean label.

campaign_dialogue.witness_3.greeting.source: I resealed the book after the novice died. Every year afterward I called it care.
campaign_dialogue.witness_3.greeting.text: I resealed the book after the novice died. Every year afterward I called it care.

campaign_dialogue.witness_3.lines.0.source: Anwen: I was afraid. That explains what I did. It does not give the unnamed people back their years.
campaign_dialogue.witness_3.lines.0.text: Anwen: I was afraid. That explains what I did. It does not give the unnamed people back their years.

campaign_dialogue.witness_3.lines.1.source: Anwen: My confession is my own. No household has to follow it to receive grain.
campaign_dialogue.witness_3.lines.1.text: Anwen: My confession is my own. No household has to follow it to receive grain.

campaign_dialogue.witness_7.greeting.source: Bram Kett. Sella Vey. Oren Vey. The older name beneath the painted crow.
campaign_dialogue.witness_7.greeting.text: Bram Kett. Sella Vey. Oren Vey. The older name beneath the painted crow.

campaign_dialogue.witness_7.lines.0.source: Kael: These pages establish what we recovered. They do not promise for the people who could not come.
campaign_dialogue.witness_7.lines.0.text: Kael: These pages establish what we recovered. They do not promise for the people who could not come.

campaign_dialogue.witness_7.lines.1.source: Kael: Leave room for what the Hart knows that our copies do not.
campaign_dialogue.witness_7.lines.1.text: Kael: Leave room for what the Hart knows that our copies do not.

conversation_topics.topics.anwen_basket_.source: For the next meals. One handle's nearly through, and the woman who carried it apologized to me.
conversation_topics.topics.anwen_basket_.text: For the next meals. One handle's nearly through, and the woman who carried it apologized to me.
conversation_topics.topics.anwen_basket_.speaker: Anwen
