dialogue.white_hart.actions.1.cost.source: A protected circle must preserve the truth; partial public acknowledgment leaves unresolved grievances.
dialogue.white_hart.actions.1.cost.text: A protected circle must preserve the truth; partial public acknowledgment leaves unresolved grievances.

dialogue.white_hart.actions.1.label.source: Mercy — release the Hart; safeguard names and private memories.
dialogue.white_hart.actions.1.label.text: Mercy — release the Hart; safeguard names and private memories.

dialogue.white_hart.actions.1.preview.source: Release the Hart while protecting private memories; institutional crimes remain on record.
dialogue.white_hart.actions.1.preview.text: Release the Hart while protecting private memories; institutional crimes remain on record.

dialogue.white_hart.actions.2.cost.source: Kael loses freedom and rest. The village gains time while the injustice remains unfinished.
dialogue.white_hart.actions.2.cost.text: Kael loses freedom and rest. The village gains time while the injustice remains unfinished.

dialogue.white_hart.actions.2.label.source: Duty — freely carry the unresolved binding myself.
dialogue.white_hart.actions.2.label.text: Duty — freely carry the unresolved binding myself.

dialogue.white_hart.actions.2.preview.source: Kael willingly carries the continuing binding. No other person is pledged.
dialogue.white_hart.actions.2.preview.text: Kael willingly carries the continuing binding. No other person is pledged.

dialogue.white_hart.actions.3.cost.source: Irreplaceable memories are lost. Dispersal harms the land and future harvests.
dialogue.white_hart.actions.3.cost.text: Irreplaceable memories are lost. Dispersal harms the land and future harvests.

dialogue.white_hart.actions.3.label.source: Ash — destroy the Hart; keep the human record and face the loss.
dialogue.white_hart.actions.3.label.text: Ash — destroy the Hart; keep the human record and face the loss.

dialogue.white_hart.actions.3.preview.source: Destroy the complete witness by combat; the copied human record survives.
dialogue.white_hart.actions.3.preview.text: Destroy the complete witness by combat; the copied human record survives.

dialogue.white_hart.greeting.source: You have kept the account where a living hand can reach it. That is something the old oath would not allow.
dialogue.white_hart.greeting.text: You have kept the account where a living hand can reach it. That is something the old oath would not allow.

dialogue.white_hart.lines.0.source: Kael: The grain condition is broken. No one standing here has to promise you anything to eat.
dialogue.white_hart.lines.0.text: Kael: The grain condition is broken. No one standing here has to promise you anything to eat.

dialogue.white_hart.lines.1.source: The White Hart: I remember the gate shut. I remember the road hidden. I remember the soldiers entering. I will not tell you those were one man's act.
dialogue.white_hart.lines.1.text: The White Hart: I remember the gate shut. I remember the road hidden. I remember the soldiers entering. I will not tell you those were one man's act.

dialogue.white_hart.lines.2.source: Kael: The copies survive. I will freely keep what we have recovered. I cannot swear for the people who refused.
dialogue.white_hart.lines.2.text: Kael: The copies survive. I will freely keep what we have recovered. I cannot swear for the people who refused.

dialogue.white_hart.lines.3.source: The White Hart: One willing keeper of an account is enough to begin. Others may share that work. None may be given it by force.
dialogue.white_hart.lines.3.text: The White Hart: One willing keeper of an account is enough to begin. Others may share that work. None may be given it by force.

dialogue.white_hart.lines.4.source: The White Hart: Make the account public and I will leave its judgment with you. Release me quietly and preserve the record without opening every private memory.
dialogue.white_hart.lines.4.text: The White Hart: Make the account public and I will leave its judgment with you. Release me quietly and preserve the record without opening every private memory.

dialogue.white_hart.lines.5.source: The White Hart: Or carry the unresolved binding yourself. Or destroy me and lose what no copy holds.
dialogue.white_hart.lines.5.text: The White Hart: Or carry the unresolved binding yourself. Or destroy me and lose what no copy holds.

dialogue.white_hart.lines.6.source: Kael: Releasing you does not erase the house's crime. Protecting a family does not protect Edric from the record.
dialogue.white_hart.lines.6.text: Kael: Releasing you does not erase the house's crime. Protecting a family does not protect Edric from the record.

dialogue.white_hart.lines.7.source: The White Hart: Then choose whose work begins when mine ends.
dialogue.white_hart.lines.7.text: The White Hart: Then choose whose work begins when mine ends.

dialogue.widow_elna.actions.0.label.source: I will hear what the bell is carrying.
dialogue.widow_elna.actions.0.label.text: I will hear what the bell is carrying.

dialogue.widow_elna.actions.2.cost.source: The act remains recorded; Elna decides whether her grief becomes public.
dialogue.widow_elna.actions.2.cost.text: The act remains recorded; Elna decides whether her grief becomes public.

dialogue.widow_elna.actions.2.label.source: Give Elna the whole account, and let her decide to speak.
dialogue.widow_elna.actions.2.label.text: Give Elna the whole account, and let her decide to speak.

dialogue.widow_elna.actions.2.preview.source: Elna names his kindness and the people he shut outside. She chooses to give the assembly what she knows.
dialogue.widow_elna.actions.2.preview.text: Elna names his kindness and the people he shut outside. She chooses to give the assembly what she knows.

dialogue.widow_elna.actions.2.result.source: Elna names his kindness and the people he shut outside. She chooses to give the assembly what she knows.
dialogue.widow_elna.actions.2.result.text: Elna names his kindness and the people he shut outside. She chooses to give the assembly what she knows.

dialogue.widow_elna.actions.3.cost.source: The act remains recorded; Elna decides whether her grief becomes public.
dialogue.widow_elna.actions.3.cost.text: The act remains recorded; Elna decides whether her grief becomes public.

dialogue.widow_elna.actions.3.label.source: Offer the gentler account. Leave the evidence with her.
dialogue.widow_elna.actions.3.label.text: Offer the gentler account. Leave the evidence with her.

dialogue.widow_elna.actions.3.preview.source: Elna receives the bell and the written record. She declines a public account; the act itself stays documented.
dialogue.widow_elna.actions.3.preview.text: Elna receives the bell and the written record. She declines a public account; the act itself stays documented.

dialogue.widow_elna.actions.3.result.source: Elna receives the bell and the written record. She declines a public account; the act itself stays documented.
dialogue.widow_elna.actions.3.result.text: Elna receives the bell and the written record. She declines a public account; the act itself stays documented.

dialogue.widow_elna.actions.4.cost.source: The act remains recorded; Elna decides whether her grief becomes public.
dialogue.widow_elna.actions.4.cost.text: The act remains recorded; Elna decides whether her grief becomes public.

dialogue.widow_elna.actions.4.label.source: Tell her everything privately. Keep her grief out of the square.
dialogue.widow_elna.actions.4.label.text: Tell her everything privately. Keep her grief out of the square.

dialogue.widow_elna.actions.4.preview.source: Elna accepts Harl's record for the family. His act remains evidence; her grief is not pledged to the assembly.
dialogue.widow_elna.actions.4.preview.text: Elna accepts Harl's record for the family. His act remains evidence; her grief is not pledged to the assembly.

dialogue.widow_elna.actions.4.result.source: Elna accepts Harl's record for the family. His act remains evidence; her grief is not pledged to the assembly.
dialogue.widow_elna.actions.4.result.text: Elna accepts Harl's record for the family. His act remains evidence; her grief is not pledged to the assembly.

dialogue.widow_elna.greeting.source: Harl used to warm my shoes by the fire. Burned one once. Hid it for a week.
dialogue.widow_elna.greeting.text: Harl used to warm my shoes by the fire. Burned one once. Hid it for a week.

dialogue.widow_elna.lines.0.source: Elna: You can know that and still hear what I ask next.
dialogue.widow_elna.lines.0.text: Elna: You can know that and still hear what I ask next.

dialogue.widow_elna.lines.1.source: Elna: His grave bell rings with the rope cut. He helped close Greyfen's gate in the war. I told our children he held it for their safety.
dialogue.widow_elna.lines.1.text: Elna: His grave bell rings with the rope cut. He helped close Greyfen's gate in the war. I told our children he held it for their safety.

dialogue.widow_elna.lines.2.source: Kael: Did he ever speak about the people outside?
dialogue.widow_elna.lines.2.text: Kael: Did he ever speak about the people outside?

dialogue.widow_elna.lines.3.source: Elna: He would stop setting the table when it rained. Find what he left. Do not decide for me that love makes me unable to hear it.
dialogue.widow_elna.lines.3.text: Elna: He would stop setting the table when it rained. Find what he left. Do not decide for me that love makes me unable to hear it.

dialogue.widow_elna.variants.0.greeting.source: I told the children he loved us. Then I told them who stood outside the gate.
dialogue.widow_elna.variants.0.greeting.text: I told the children he loved us. Then I told them who stood outside the gate.

dialogue.widow_elna.variants.0.lines.0.source: Elna: My daughter asked if both were true. I said yes.
dialogue.widow_elna.variants.0.lines.0.text: Elna: My daughter asked if both were true. I said yes.

dialogue.widow_elna.variants.0.lines.1.source: Kael: Will you speak at the assembly?
dialogue.widow_elna.variants.0.lines.1.text: Kael: Will you speak at the assembly?

dialogue.widow_elna.variants.0.lines.2.source: Elna: About what I know. His victims do not need me performing my grief over their names.
dialogue.widow_elna.variants.0.lines.2.text: Elna: About what I know. His victims do not need me performing my grief over their names.

dialogue.widow_elna.variants.1.greeting.source: I put the bell in the drawer. It is quieter in there.
dialogue.widow_elna.variants.1.greeting.text: I put the bell in the drawer. It is quieter in there.

dialogue.widow_elna.variants.1.lines.0.source: Elna: You offered me a gentler account. I heard what you left out.
dialogue.widow_elna.variants.1.lines.0.text: Elna: You offered me a gentler account. I heard what you left out.

dialogue.widow_elna.variants.1.lines.2.source: Elna: Then leave it where the children can find it when they ask.
dialogue.widow_elna.variants.1.lines.2.text: Elna: Then leave it where the children can find it when they ask.

dialogue.widow_elna.variants.2.greeting.source: The children have the account. I will not read it in the square.
dialogue.widow_elna.variants.2.greeting.text: The children have the account. I will not read it in the square.

dialogue.widow_elna.variants.2.lines.0.source: Elna: You may name what Harl did. You may not use my kitchen as proof I have forgiven it.
dialogue.widow_elna.variants.2.lines.0.text: Elna: You may name what Harl did. You may not use my kitchen as proof I have forgiven it.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_ash.g.source: Nothing answered when I rang the bell.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_ash.g.text: Nothing answered when I rang the bell.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_ash.l.source: Kael: Were you hoping it would?
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_ash.l.text: Kael: Were you hoping it would?

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_ash.l.source: Anwen: I don't know. That is the honest answer today.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_ash.l.text: Anwen: I don't know. That is the honest answer today.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_ash.l.source: The copied command and the household register lie on her table. Human hands saved them before the glade burned. Their evidence has not become less true because its witness is gone.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_ash.l.text: The copied command and the household register lie on her table. Human hands saved them before the glade burned. Their evidence has not become less true because its witness is gone.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_ash.l.source: Anwen: There are things we can no longer ask. We must mark those gaps instead of filling them with convenient answers.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_ash.l.text: Anwen: There are things we can no longer ask. We must mark those gaps instead of filling them with convenient answers.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_ash.l.source: A father passing the table says his child slept without hearing voices. Anwen listens until he has finished.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_ash.l.text: A father passing the table says his child slept without hearing voices. Anwen listens until he has finished.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_ash.l.source: Kael: We keep what remains. And answer for what we chose.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_ash.l.text: Kael: We keep what remains. And answer for what we chose.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_ash.l.source: Anwen: Tor needs another pair of hands. The next repair cannot wait for us to feel certain.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_ash.l.text: Anwen: Tor needs another pair of hands. The next repair cannot wait for us to feel certain.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_duty..source: The silence held through the night. I kept waking to make sure.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_duty..text: The silence held through the night. I kept waking to make sure.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_duty..source: Kael: I felt the road when I woke. Not words. Weight.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_duty..text: Kael: I felt the road when I woke. Not words. Weight.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_duty..source: Anwen: Then we write the limits now, while people are grateful enough to forget them. You did not accept every order anyone might give you.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_duty..text: Anwen: Then we write the limits now, while people are grateful enough to forget them. You did not accept every order anyone might give you.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_duty..source: She writes that the keeping is Kael's choice. No child inherits it. No shortage can compel another keeper. The old command remains beside it, uncensored.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_duty..text: She writes that the keeping is Kael's choice. No child inherits it. No shortage can compel another keeper. The old command remains beside it, uncensored.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_duty..source: Kael: If I cannot keep it?
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_duty..text: Kael: If I cannot keep it?

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_duty..source: Anwen: We meet again. We tell the truth about the cost. We do not turn your promise into an excuse to stop thinking.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_duty..text: Anwen: We meet again. We tell the truth about the cost. We do not turn your promise into an excuse to stop thinking.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_duty..source: Kael reads the lines before signing. The tremor in his hand is his own.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_duty..text: Kael reads the lines before signing. The tremor in his hand is his own.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_duty..source: Anwen: Tor has a repair for you. Something ordinary. Let him do it.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_duty..text: Anwen: Tor has a repair for you. Something ordinary. Let him do it.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_mercy.source: This copy names the offices, the orders and those who gave them. This other book belongs to the families.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_mercy.text: This copy names the offices, the orders and those who gave them. This other book belongs to the families.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_mercy.source: Anwen: The people whose lives it holds. They may let someone else read. They may refuse.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_mercy.text: Anwen: The people whose lives it holds. They may let someone else read. They may refuse.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_mercy.source: A woman returns a sealed page. She asks Anwen to keep her son's name and destroy the account of his last fear. Anwen asks once whether she is certain, then follows her instruction.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_mercy.text: A woman returns a sealed page. She asks Anwen to keep her son's name and destroy the account of his last fear. Anwen asks once whether she is certain, then follows her instruction.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_mercy.source: Kael: Edric's order stays on the wall.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_mercy.text: Kael: Edric's order stays on the wall.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_mercy.source: Anwen: Yes. His privacy was never the thing we were protecting.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_mercy.text: Anwen: Yes. His privacy was never the thing we were protecting.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_mercy.source: For the first time, the bell can mourn someone without claiming everything that happened to them.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_mercy.text: For the first time, the bell can mourn someone without claiming everything that happened to them.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_mercy.source: Anwen: The living still need timber and flour. Tor is at the bench. There is a world outside these books.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_mercy.text: Anwen: The living still need timber and flour. Tor is at the bench. There is a world outside these books.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_witne.source: I thought writing them where everyone could see would make my hands stop shaking.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_witne.text: I thought writing them where everyone could see would make my hands stop shaking.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_witne.source: Anwen: Bram. Sella. Oren. I have practiced saying the names of the dead more often than I have spoken to the people who miss them.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_witne.text: Anwen: Bram. Sella. Oren. I have practiced saying the names of the dead more often than I have spoken to the people who miss them.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_witne.source: A man waiting at the wall asks who will pay for the land his mother was refused. Anwen puts his question beneath the names instead of sending him away.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_witne.text: A man waiting at the wall asks who will pay for the land his mother was refused. Anwen puts his question beneath the names instead of sending him away.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_witne.source: Anwen: We cannot promise every answer today.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_witne.text: Anwen: We cannot promise every answer today.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_witne.source: Kael: We can promise this question will still be here tomorrow.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_witne.text: Kael: We can promise this question will still be here tomorrow.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_witne.source: Anwen leaves room on the board. The public account is no longer a ceremony that ends when the bell stops.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_witne.text: Anwen leaves room on the board. The public account is no longer a ceremony that ends when the bell stops.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_witne.source: Anwen: Tor has begun measuring timber. Rook is arguing about who gets the first load. Go help them make this more than my handwriting.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_names_witne.text: Anwen: Tor has begun measuring timber. Rook is arguing about who gets the first load. Go help them make this more than my handwriting.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_ash.gr.source: Wind crosses the road without forming a voice. A patch of earth where oathgrass grew is bare.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_ash.gr.text: Wind crosses the road without forming a voice. A patch of earth where oathgrass grew is bare.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_ash.li.source: Kael kneels and presses a seed into the ordinary soil. He cannot make it take root by promising.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_ash.li.text: Kael kneels and presses a seed into the ordinary soil. He cannot make it take root by promising.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_ash.li.source: Kael: We can water it. We can come back.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_ash.li.text: Kael: We can water it. We can come back.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_ash.li.source: The destroyed witness cannot answer the questions no one thought to ask. The human record can still accuse the powerful. The living can still choose what they owe each other.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_ash.li.text: The destroyed witness cannot answer the questions no one thought to ask. The human record can still accuse the powerful. The living can still choose what they owe each other.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_ash.li.source: Kael stands. The quiet is relief, and it is absence. He carries both toward Greyfen.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_ash.li.text: Kael stands. The quiet is relief, and it is absence. He carries both toward Greyfen.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_ash.li.source: Your campaign outcome is kept. Greyfen and the discovered roads remain open for unfinished conversations and work.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_ash.li.text: Your campaign outcome is kept. Greyfen and the discovered roads remain open for unfinished conversations and work.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_duty.g.source: At the village edge, Kael feels where the old road bends even with his eyes closed.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_duty.g.text: At the village edge, Kael feels where the old road bends even with his eyes closed.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_duty.l.source: Rook: How far does it follow you?
interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_duty.l.text: Rook: How far does it follow you?

interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_duty.l.source: Kael: I will have to learn.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_duty.l.text: Kael: I will have to learn.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_duty.l.source: Rook: Then don't answer for all the years today.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_duty.l.text: Rook: Then don't answer for all the years today.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_duty.l.source: The boundary is quieter. The injustice it covered has not been repaired by one man's willingness to stand here. The written account waits in Greyfen, where other people can begin their own work.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_duty.l.text: The boundary is quieter. The injustice it covered has not been repaired by one man's willingness to stand here. The written account waits in Greyfen, where other people can begin their own work.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_duty.l.source: Kael opens his eyes. His oath has limits. His life must still have room inside them.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_duty.l.text: Kael opens his eyes. His oath has limits. His life must still have room inside them.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_duty.l.source: Your campaign outcome is kept. Greyfen and the discovered roads remain open for unfinished conversations and work.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_duty.l.text: Your campaign outcome is kept. Greyfen and the discovered roads remain open for unfinished conversations and work.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_mercy..source: A strip of linen moves beside the road. It carries no confession and names no debtor.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_mercy..text: A strip of linen moves beside the road. It carries no confession and names no debtor.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_mercy..source: Kael: They asked for a marker. Nothing more.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_mercy..text: Kael: They asked for a marker. Nothing more.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_mercy..source: Rook: Then it can be nothing more.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_mercy..text: Rook: Then it can be nothing more.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_mercy..source: The released memories do not arrive to correct the village's version of itself. People must preserve the records, challenge the convenient lie, and let one another keep what was never owed to a crowd.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_mercy..text: The released memories do not arrive to correct the village's version of itself. People must preserve the records, challenge the convenient lie, and let one another keep what was never owed to a crowd.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_mercy..source: Kael turns toward the kitchen. There are names he will speak there, and names he will wait to be invited to speak.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_mercy..text: Kael turns toward the kitchen. There are names he will speak there, and names he will wait to be invited to speak.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_mercy..source: No one mistakes the work ahead for permission to bind the dead again.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_mercy..text: No one mistakes the work ahead for permission to bind the dead again.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_mercy..source: Your campaign outcome is kept. Greyfen and the discovered roads remain open for unfinished conversations and work.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_mercy..text: Your campaign outcome is kept. Greyfen and the discovered roads remain open for unfinished conversations and work.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_witnes.source: The notice at the village edge carries the first names, the first claims, and a time for the next meeting.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_witnes.text: The notice at the village edge carries the first names, the first claims, and a time for the next meeting.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_witnes.source: Kael: A public promise has a place people can return to.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_witnes.text: Kael: A public promise has a place people can return to.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_witnes.source: Some will come to demand restitution. Some will come to defend what they have. The account will need witnesses after the extraordinary witness is gone.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_witnes.text: Some will come to demand restitution. Some will come to defend what they have. The account will need witnesses after the extraordinary witness is gone.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_witnes.source: Rook: Will you be here when they arrive?
interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_witnes.text: Rook: Will you be here when they arrive?

interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_witnes.source: Kael: I said I would keep it.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_witnes.text: Kael: I said I would keep it.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_witnes.source: He takes the road back toward the kitchen. This time, returning is part of the oath.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_witnes.text: He takes the road back toward the kitchen. This time, returning is part of the oath.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_witnes.source: Your campaign outcome is kept. Greyfen and the discovered roads remain open for unfinished conversations and work.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_road_witnes.text: Your campaign outcome is kept. Greyfen and the discovered roads remain open for unfinished conversations and work.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_ash.gr.source: There is ash in the grain sack's folded seam. Rook brushes it into his palm before opening the flour.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_ash.gr.text: There is ash in the grain sack's folded seam. Rook brushes it into his palm before opening the flour.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_ash.li.source: Rook: It got everywhere. Doesn't mean everything is ruined.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_ash.li.text: Rook: It got everywhere. Doesn't mean everything is ruined.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_ash.li.source: Tor: No. Doesn't mean it didn't cost anything either.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_ash.li.text: Tor: No. Doesn't mean it didn't cost anything either.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_ash.li.source: Kael helps separate the scorched boards from the sound ones. One will become a shelf. Another breaks under his hand and is set aside.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_ash.li.text: Kael helps separate the scorched boards from the sound ones. One will become a shelf. Another breaks under his hand and is set aside.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_ash.li.source: Kael: I cannot put it back.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_ash.li.text: Kael: I cannot put it back.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_ash.li.source: Tor: I didn't ask you to. Hold this end.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_ash.li.text: Tor: I didn't ask you to. Hold this end.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_ash.li.source: They finish one repair without deciding what the whole choice meant. In the kitchen, someone laughs at an ordinary mistake.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_ash.li.text: They finish one repair without deciding what the whole choice meant. In the kitchen, someone laughs at an ordinary mistake.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_ash.li.source: Rook: Listen. I missed that. We can miss what was lost and still be glad to hear it.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_ash.li.text: Rook: Listen. I missed that. We can miss what was lost and still be glad to hear it.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_duty.g.source: Tor reaches for Kael's worn strap before asking about the glade.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_duty.g.text: Tor reaches for Kael's worn strap before asking about the glade.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_duty.l.source: Tor: Sit. If you're going to stand watch, you can at least stop this buckle cutting your shoulder.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_duty.l.text: Tor: Sit. If you're going to stand watch, you can at least stop this buckle cutting your shoulder.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_duty.l.source: Tor: This is one of them.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_duty.l.text: Tor: This is one of them.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_duty.l.source: Rook lays out the roads that still need walking. He marks a place for Kael to rest and a name beside each delivery. None of those names is entered as a new keeper.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_duty.l.text: Rook lays out the roads that still need walking. He marks a place for Kael to rest and a name beside each delivery. None of those names is entered as a new keeper.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_duty.l.source: Rook: Help isn't the same thing as taking your oath. We can carry supper without carrying the Hart.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_duty.l.text: Rook: Help isn't the same thing as taking your oath. We can carry supper without carrying the Hart.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_duty.l.source: Kael holds the leather while Tor stitches. For a little while, his chosen burden fits beside someone else's ordinary skill.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_duty.l.text: Kael holds the leather while Tor stitches. For a little while, his chosen burden fits beside someone else's ordinary skill.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_duty.l.source: Tor: Come back before it splits again. That is a request, not a sacred duty.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_duty.l.text: Tor: Come back before it splits again. That is a request, not a sacred duty.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_mercy..source: Rook has tied a strip of plain linen around a basket with no name on it.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_mercy..text: Rook has tied a strip of plain linen around a basket with no name on it.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_mercy..source: Rook: To someone who asked me not to tell everyone where it goes.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_mercy..text: Rook: To someone who asked me not to tell everyone where it goes.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_mercy..source: Tor: You can still count the flour without counting the family's grief.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_mercy..text: Tor: You can still count the flour without counting the family's grief.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_mercy..source: Kael steadies a plank against Tor's bench. Together they cut a lid for the basket; Rook folds the linen beneath it so the rain cannot reach the meal.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_mercy..text: Kael steadies a plank against Tor's bench. Together they cut a lid for the basket; Rook folds the linen beneath it so the rain cannot reach the meal.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_mercy..source: Rook: Keeping a confidence used to mean hiding my own part. I'll have to learn the difference.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_mercy..text: Rook: Keeping a confidence used to mean hiding my own part. I'll have to learn the difference.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_mercy..source: Kael: Ask whose safety the silence serves.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_mercy..text: Kael: Ask whose safety the silence serves.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_mercy..source: Rook takes the basket through the square openly. Its destination remains the recipient's business.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_mercy..text: Rook takes the basket through the square openly. Its destination remains the recipient's business.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_witnes.source: Tor lays a damaged hinge on the bench. Rook lays three incompatible requests beside it.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_witnes.text: Tor lays a damaged hinge on the bench. Rook lays three incompatible requests beside it.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_witnes.source: Rook: The west field wants its gate. The kitchen wants its cart. The chapel wants a board large enough to accuse the whole county.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_witnes.text: Rook: The west field wants its gate. The kitchen wants its cart. The chapel wants a board large enough to accuse the whole county.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_witnes.source: Tor: The chapel can have the offcuts.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_witnes.text: Tor: The chapel can have the offcuts.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_witnes.source: Kael holds the hinge while Tor drives out its old pin. The iron bears the same stamp as the weapon that brought him here.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_witnes.text: Kael holds the hinge while Tor drives out its old pin. The iron bears the same stamp as the weapon that brought him here.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_witnes.source: Kael: Who decides whose repair comes first?
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_witnes.text: Kael: Who decides whose repair comes first?

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_witnes.source: Rook: Today? The people standing here. Tomorrow we'll need something better than whoever shouts loudest.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_witnes.text: Rook: Today? The people standing here. Tomorrow we'll need something better than whoever shouts loudest.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_witnes.source: Tor: Put that on Anwen's board.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_witnes.text: Tor: Put that on Anwen's board.

interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_witnes.source: The first repair is small enough to finish. Beyond it lies work no ending could have finished for them.
interaction_scenes.aftermath_work_witnes.text: The first repair is small enough to finish. Beyond it lies work no ending could have finished for them.

interaction_scenes.opening_care_coat.gre.source: That is Oren's. Leave the pockets turned in; he keeps things in them.
interaction_scenes.opening_care_coat.gre.text: That is Oren's. Leave the pockets turned in; he keeps things in them.

interaction_scenes.opening_care_coat.lin.source: The small coat is heavier at one cuff. Three crooked red stitches hold a tear shut. Kael folds the sleeve beneath it, clear of the wet edge.
interaction_scenes.opening_care_coat.lin.text: The small coat is heavier at one cuff. Three crooked red stitches hold a tear shut. Kael folds the sleeve beneath it, clear of the wet edge.
interaction_scenes.opening_care_coat.lin.speaker: Narrator

interaction_scenes.opening_care_coat.lin.source: Anwen: He did. I threaded the needle. He would not let me do the rest.
interaction_scenes.opening_care_coat.lin.text: Anwen: He did. I threaded the needle. He would not let me do the rest.

interaction_scenes.opening_care_coat.lin.source: Anwen: Bram drove the cart. Sella took Oren beside her. He left this because the sun was out.
interaction_scenes.opening_care_coat.lin.text: Anwen: Bram drove the cart. Sella took Oren beside her. He left this because the sun was out.

interaction_scenes.opening_care_coat.lin.source: Anwen leaves room on the bench beside the coat. She has not put it away.
interaction_scenes.opening_care_coat.lin.text: Anwen leaves room on the bench beside the coat. She has not put it away.
interaction_scenes.opening_care_coat.lin.speaker: Narrator

interaction_scenes.opening_care_invitati.source: I'll help here for a moment.
interaction_scenes.opening_care_invitati.text: I'll help here for a moment.

interaction_scenes.opening_care_invitati.source: Tell me about the missing travelers.
interaction_scenes.opening_care_invitati.text: Tell me about the missing travelers.

interaction_scenes.opening_care_invitati.source: A moment, hunter. The man behind that screen cannot reach his water.
interaction_scenes.opening_care_invitati.text: A moment, hunter. The man behind that screen cannot reach his water.

interaction_scenes.opening_care_invitati.source: Anwen: The cup is on the step. Leave it on the linen by his hand, if you would.
interaction_scenes.opening_care_invitati.text: Anwen: The cup is on the step. Leave it on the linen by his hand, if you would.

interaction_scenes.opening_care_invitati.source: Anwen: And that little coat on the bench belongs under the shelf. Oren will complain if I let the rain into his pockets.
interaction_scenes.opening_care_invitati.text: Anwen: And that little coat on the bench belongs under the shelf. Oren will complain if I let the rain into his pockets.

interaction_scenes.opening_care_invitati.source: Thank you for the water. He has stopped trying to stand.
interaction_scenes.opening_care_invitati.text: Thank you for the water. He has stopped trying to stand.

interaction_scenes.opening_care_invitati.source: Anwen: Would you move that little coat under the shelf? Oren left it here this morning. He said he would be too hot.
interaction_scenes.opening_care_invitati.text: Anwen: Would you move that little coat under the shelf? Oren left it here this morning. He said he would be too hot.

interaction_scenes.opening_care_invitati.source: You found a dry place for his coat. Thank you.
interaction_scenes.opening_care_invitati.text: You found a dry place for his coat. Thank you.

interaction_scenes.opening_care_invitati.source: Anwen: The man behind the screen needs the cup on the step. Leave it on the linen by his hand, if you would.
interaction_scenes.opening_care_invitati.text: Anwen: The man behind the screen needs the cup on the step. Leave it on the linen by his hand, if you would.

interaction_scenes.opening_care_water.gr.source: There. Close enough that he need not ask again.
interaction_scenes.opening_care_water.gr.text: There. Close enough that he need not ask again.

interaction_scenes.opening_care_water.li.source: A hand comes beneath the screen. It steadies the cup against the wood before lifting it.
interaction_scenes.opening_care_water.li.text: A hand comes beneath the screen. It steadies the cup against the wood before lifting it.
interaction_scenes.opening_care_water.li.speaker: Narrator

interaction_scenes.opening_care_water.li.source: Kael: Was he with the missing cart?
interaction_scenes.opening_care_water.li.text: Kael: Was he with the missing cart?

interaction_scenes.opening_care_water.li.source: Anwen: No. A fall on the south road. Not every hurt here is a sign, Kael. Some people only need water.
interaction_scenes.opening_care_water.li.text: Anwen: No. A fall on the south road. Not every hurt here is a sign, Kael. Some people only need water.

interaction_scenes.opening_care_water.li.source: The cup comes back to the linen. For a moment, the breathing behind the screen is easier.
interaction_scenes.opening_care_water.li.text: The cup comes back to the linen. For a moment, the breathing behind the screen is easier.
interaction_scenes.opening_care_water.li.speaker: Narrator

interaction_scenes.soldiers_stand_down.g.source: The nearest soldier lets his sword point fall into the mud. The other watches Senn before doing the same.
interaction_scenes.soldiers_stand_down.g.text: The nearest soldier lets his sword point fall into the mud. The other watches Senn before doing the same.

interaction_scenes.soldiers_stand_down.l.source: Soldier: He said Greyfen would leave us hungry if we stopped taking what passed.
interaction_scenes.soldiers_stand_down.l.text: Soldier: He said Greyfen would leave us hungry if we stopped taking what passed.

interaction_scenes.soldiers_stand_down.l.source: Kael: I cannot promise nobody will ask what you took. I can promise supper is not a reward for obeying him.
interaction_scenes.soldiers_stand_down.l.text: Kael: I cannot promise nobody will ask what you took. I can promise supper is not a reward for obeying him.

interaction_scenes.soldiers_stand_down.l.source: Kael: Then you speak for yourselves. Lowering a weapon does not sign your name to anyone else's account.
interaction_scenes.soldiers_stand_down.l.text: Kael: Then you speak for yourselves. Lowering a weapon does not sign your name to anyone else's account.

interaction_scenes.soldiers_stand_down.l.source: The road clears. Senn remains beside the table, without a line of men between his answers and the people he hurt.
interaction_scenes.soldiers_stand_down.l.text: The road clears. Senn remains beside the table, without a line of men between his answers and the people he hurt.

interaction_scenes.work_cart_finish.gree.source: Mind the corner. That sack has already had a worse journey than either of us.
interaction_scenes.work_cart_finish.gree.text: Mind the corner. That sack has already had a worse journey than either of us.

interaction_scenes.work_cart_finish.line.source: Kael: The wheel will need lifting before it can turn.
interaction_scenes.work_cart_finish.line.text: Kael: The wheel will need lifting before it can turn.

interaction_scenes.work_cart_finish.line.source: Rook: It will. The flour needed feeding to people before it needed feeding to mud.
interaction_scenes.work_cart_finish.line.text: Rook: It will. The flour needed feeding to people before it needed feeding to mud.

interaction_scenes.work_cart_finish.line.source: A woman at the kitchen opens the sack and measures three small shares. She keeps the string for mending.
interaction_scenes.work_cart_finish.line.text: A woman at the kitchen opens the sack and measures three small shares. She keeps the string for mending.

interaction_scenes.work_cart_finish.line.source: Rook: There. Something went where we said it would. I could get used to that.
interaction_scenes.work_cart_finish.line.text: Rook: There. Something went where we said it would. I could get used to that.

interaction_scenes.work_cart_return.gree.source: The kitchen has the flour. The cart is lighter.
interaction_scenes.work_cart_return.gree.text: The kitchen has the flour. The cart is lighter.

interaction_scenes.work_cart_return.line.source: Rook: I've told them you did the heavy bit. Don't make me a liar by offering to do it all again.
interaction_scenes.work_cart_return.line.text: Rook: I've told them you did the heavy bit. Don't make me a liar by offering to do it all again.

interaction_scenes.work_relief_finish.gr.source: The two empty baskets return together.
interaction_scenes.work_relief_finish.gr.text: The two empty baskets return together.

interaction_scenes.work_relief_finish.li.source: Mira: Did anyone ask what they had to promise?
interaction_scenes.work_relief_finish.li.text: Mira: Did anyone ask what they had to promise?

interaction_scenes.work_relief_finish.li.source: Kael: I told her the basket was not a contract.
interaction_scenes.work_relief_finish.li.text: Kael: I told her the basket was not a contract.

interaction_scenes.work_relief_finish.li.source: Mira: Tell her again tomorrow. People don't learn that sort of thing in one meal.
interaction_scenes.work_relief_finish.li.text: Mira: Tell her again tomorrow. People don't learn that sort of thing in one meal.

interaction_scenes.work_relief_return.gr.source: The household shares have been delivered.
interaction_scenes.work_relief_return.gr.text: The household shares have been delivered.

interaction_scenes.work_relief_return.li.source: Names in the ledger mark who has eaten. They do not mark who owes obedience.
interaction_scenes.work_relief_return.li.text: Names in the ledger mark who has eaten. They do not mark who owes obedience.

interaction_scenes.work_road_finish.gree.source: Leave the peg proud. Someone will need to pull it out when the next flood comes.
interaction_scenes.work_road_finish.gree.text: Leave the peg proud. Someone will need to pull it out when the next flood comes.

interaction_scenes.work_road_finish.line.source: Kael: You expect it to fail?
interaction_scenes.work_road_finish.line.text: Kael: You expect it to fail?

interaction_scenes.work_road_finish.line.source: Tor: I expect someone to repair it. A thing can be well made without being the last thing anyone ever makes.
interaction_scenes.work_road_finish.line.text: Tor: I expect someone to repair it. A thing can be well made without being the last thing anyone ever makes.

interaction_scenes.work_road_finish.line.source: Water threads through the cleared drain. Rook's empty wheel crosses the boards without sinking.
interaction_scenes.work_road_finish.line.text: Water threads through the cleared drain. Rook's empty wheel crosses the boards without sinking.

interaction_scenes.work_road_finish.line.source: Tor: There. A road ought to carry the person using it. Start with that.
interaction_scenes.work_road_finish.line.text: Tor: There. A road ought to carry the person using it. Start with that.

interaction_scenes.work_road_return.gree.source: Water's still moving. Boards are still holding.
interaction_scenes.work_road_return.gree.text: Water's still moving. Boards are still holding.

interaction_scenes.work_road_return.line.source: Tor: If you're looking for praise, ask the wheel. It made the most noise about it before.
interaction_scenes.work_road_return.line.text: Tor: If you're looking for praise, ask the wheel. It made the most noise about it before.

items.ash_bomb.description.source: A clay bomb packed with ash-salt and sparkstone.
items.ash_bomb.description.text: A clay bomb packed with ash-salt and sparkstone.

items.ashfire_arrow.description.source: A wrapped head that burns with a brief oath-flame on impact.
items.ashfire_arrow.description.text: A wrapped head that burns with a brief oath-flame on impact.

items.bodkin_arrow.description.source: A narrow iron head made to find the gap in armor.
items.bodkin_arrow.description.text: A narrow iron head made to find the gap in armor.

items.iron_trap.description.source: A sprung jaw that slows beasts long enough to strike.
items.iron_trap.description.text: A sprung jaw that slows beasts long enough to strike.

items.moon_oil.description.source: Silver-blue oil that bites deep into spirits.
items.moon_oil.description.text: Silver-blue oil that bites deep into spirits.

items.redroot_potion.description.source: A bitter draught that restores health immediately.
items.redroot_potion.description.text: A bitter draught that restores health immediately.

items.rot_oil.description.source: A rancid oil brewed for grave-things and restless dead.
items.rot_oil.description.text: A rancid oil brewed for grave-things and restless dead.

items.standard_arrow.description.source: A balanced hunting arrow for ordinary targets.
items.standard_arrow.description.text: A balanced hunting arrow for ordinary targets.

journal_evidence_details.details.bram.se.source: The tool, brake and ledger preserve parts of his last work. They do not show the whole attack or identify the hand that began it.
journal_evidence_details.details.bram.se.text: The tool, brake and ledger preserve parts of his last work. They do not show the whole attack or identify the hand that began it.

journal_evidence_details.details.bram.se.source: Bram stayed with the damaged wagon. An account that says he simply abandoned it leaves out the work visible here.
journal_evidence_details.details.bram.se.text: Bram stayed with the damaged wagon. An account that says he simply abandoned it leaves out the work visible here.

journal_evidence_details.details.bram.se.source: Bram's marked tool and the repair traces place him beside the cart. His ledger holds a page of crossed-out debts; his hand still grips the brake.
journal_evidence_details.details.bram.se.text: Bram's marked tool and the repair traces place him beside the cart. His ledger holds a page of crossed-out debts; his hand still grips the brake.

journal_evidence_details.details.command.source: Halvern recalls the promise of sanctuary, his refusal to close the road, and his execution. His memory ends there. It cannot testify about Edric's later decisions, and preserving it does not create a consenting living witness.
journal_evidence_details.details.command.text: Halvern recalls the promise of sanctuary, his refusal to close the road, and his execution. His memory ends there. It cannot testify about Edric's later decisions, and preserving it does not create a consenting living witness.

journal_evidence_details.details.command.source: A copied order establishes its written terms. It cannot supply every later memory or make a present person assent to a replacement oath.
journal_evidence_details.details.command.text: A copied order establishes its written terms. It cannot supply every later memory or make a present person assent to a replacement oath.

journal_evidence_details.details.command.source: The command and register connect the people promised refuge to the actions taken against them. Distinct entries preserve distinct parts in that sequence; keeping them together makes the account harder to reduce to a single excuse.
journal_evidence_details.details.command.text: The command and register connect the people promised refuge to the actions taken against them. Distinct entries preserve distinct parts in that sequence; keeping them together makes the account harder to reduce to a single excuse.

journal_evidence_details.details.command.source: The ledger records sanctuary promised under a Vargan seal, the road closed, and refugee wagons transferred to shrine custody. The columns are written by different hands. The register preserves names separately from the command.
journal_evidence_details.details.command.text: The ledger records sanctuary promised under a Vargan seal, the road closed, and refugee wagons transferred to shrine custody. The columns are written by different hands. The register preserves names separately from the command.

journal_evidence_details.details.drag_ma.source: A pattern of movement supports that reading. It does not give the creatures' own account, or establish who directed every movement.
journal_evidence_details.details.drag_ma.text: A pattern of movement supports that reading. It does not give the creatures' own account, or establish who directed every movement.

journal_evidence_details.details.drag_ma.source: Kael takes this selection to mean that the creatures were gathering testimony. Hunger does not explain why these objects mattered more than the food.
journal_evidence_details.details.drag_ma.text: Kael takes this selection to mean that the creatures were gathering testimony. Hunger does not explain why these objects mattered more than the food.

journal_evidence_details.details.drag_ma.source: The drag marks pass untouched food sacks and follow the belongings that carry names. The supplies were available; they were left behind.
journal_evidence_details.details.drag_ma.text: The drag marks pass untouched food sacks and follow the belongings that carry names. The supplies were available; they were left behind.

journal_evidence_details.details.grave_c.source: The thread does not establish the child's name. Similar material elsewhere cannot fill that absence without a further recorded connection.
journal_evidence_details.details.grave_c.text: The thread does not establish the child's name. Similar material elsewhere cannot fill that absence without a further recorded connection.

journal_evidence_details.details.grave_c.source: The thread connects the burial rites to the work of keeping memory disordered. The grave holds evidence of concealment as well as loss.
journal_evidence_details.details.grave_c.text: The thread connects the burial rites to the work of keeping memory disordered. The grave holds evidence of concealment as well as loss.

journal_evidence_details.details.grave_c.source: Shrine thread is tied from within the unnamed grave. The binding is part of the burial, not merely something dropped beside it.
journal_evidence_details.details.grave_c.text: Shrine thread is tied from within the unnamed grave. The binding is part of the burial, not merely something dropped beside it.

journal_evidence_details.details.grave_h.source: A retained act cannot restore an intact husband or decide what his widow must make public. The account and her participation remain separate.
journal_evidence_details.details.grave_h.text: A retained act cannot restore an intact husband or decide what his widow must make public. The account and her participation remain separate.

journal_evidence_details.details.grave_h.source: The surviving account concerns a gate. It preserves that part of Harl's past without returning the whole man who lived beyond it.
journal_evidence_details.details.grave_h.text: The surviving account concerns a gate. It preserves that part of Harl's past without returning the whole man who lived beyond it.

journal_evidence_details.details.grave_h.source: Road mud lies within Harl's disturbed burial. What belongs to the road has entered the place where Greyfen laid him to rest.
journal_evidence_details.details.grave_h.text: Road mud lies within Harl's disturbed burial. What belongs to the road has entered the place where Greyfen laid him to rest.

journal_evidence_details.details.grave_s.source: An object cannot answer on a person's behalf. Any surviving watch fragment may preserve a fact; that does not make it a living witness able to consent to a new oath.
journal_evidence_details.details.grave_s.text: An object cannot answer on a person's behalf. Any surviving watch fragment may preserve a fact; that does not make it a living witness able to consent to a new oath.

journal_evidence_details.details.grave_s.source: The workmanship connects the grave to Vargan. The mark identifies that connection more securely than it identifies every person involved.
journal_evidence_details.details.grave_s.text: The workmanship connects the grave to Vargan. The mark identifies that connection more securely than it identifies every person involved.

journal_evidence_details.details.grave_s.source: The soldier's grave is empty. A buckle carrying Vargan work remains within it.
journal_evidence_details.details.grave_s.text: The soldier's grave is empty. A buckle carrying Vargan work remains within it.

journal_evidence_details.details.mill_ac.source: Useful flour does not erase the source recorded here. The ledger also does not make the households receiving it responsible for choosing what was ground into the system.
journal_evidence_details.details.mill_ac.text: Useful flour does not erase the source recorded here. The ledger also does not make the households receiving it responsible for choosing what was ground into the system.

journal_evidence_details.details.mill_ac.source: The mill's weights match the missing refugee wagons. Its account connects what was taken from those wagons to machinery that still supplies Greyfen's households.
journal_evidence_details.details.mill_ac.text: The mill's weights match the missing refugee wagons. Its account connects what was taken from those wagons to machinery that still supplies Greyfen's households.

journal_evidence_details.details.mill_ac.source: The account can be preserved while the mill's future is decided. Evidence about its past and a way to feed the living both need attention; one cannot do the other's work.
journal_evidence_details.details.mill_ac.text: The account can be preserved while the mill's future is decided. Evidence about its past and a way to feed the living both need attention; one cannot do the other's work.

journal_evidence_details.details.oren.se.source: The token cannot supply the whole account of Oren's death. It also cannot, by itself, give a name to another unnamed burial.
journal_evidence_details.details.oren.se.text: The token cannot supply the whole account of Oren's death. It also cannot, by itself, give a name to another unnamed burial.

journal_evidence_details.details.oren.se.source: Wear preserves the trace of a familiar possession; the altered name points to deliberate interference with what it remembers. Those are different parts of the same object.
journal_evidence_details.details.oren.se.text: Wear preserves the trace of a familiar possession; the altered name points to deliberate interference with what it remembers. Those are different parts of the same object.

journal_evidence_details.details.oren.se.source: The wooden crow's wings are worn smooth. Its name has been scraped away, and the painted crow covers an older name token. The marks follow work on the name rather than damage across the whole object.
journal_evidence_details.details.oren.se.text: The wooden crow's wings are worn smooth. Its name has been scraped away, and the painted crow covers an older name token. The marks follow work on the name rather than damage across the whole object.

journal_evidence_details.details.oren.so.source: Oren's wooden crow and the altered token
journal_evidence_details.details.oren.so.text: Oren's wooden crow and the altered token

journal_evidence_details.details.renewal.source: The ration condition was removed at the assembly. Refusing participation no longer forfeits food or a safe way out. The original proclamation remains evidence of the condition that was challenged.
journal_evidence_details.details.renewal.text: The ration condition was removed at the assembly. Refusing participation no longer forfeits food or a safe way out. The original proclamation remains evidence of the condition that was challenged.

journal_evidence_details.details.renewal.source: The proclamation records what the order demanded. It does not record each household's wishes or allow anyone to supply their consent.
